summary: Backend sanity check for /api/sitemap.xml and /api/robots.txt on preview backend (127.0.0.1:8001). Both endpoints return HTTP 200 with correct content types. Sitemap XML is valid, parses successfully, root tag is urlset in sitemaps.org namespace, contains 141 <url><loc> entries. robots.txt contains a Sitemap: directive.

minor.issue: Sitemap directive points to 'https://ventureshrd.com/api/sitemap.xml' instead of the canonical 'https://ventureshrd.com/sitemap.xml' (which is what the request contract expected, and matches the URL prod is proxied to). Google will still follow /api/sitemap.xml since it returns 200 valid XML, but the cleaner canonical URL /sitemap.xml would be preferable for GSC submission and consistency with the proxied public URL.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Update robots.txt Sitemap directive from 'https://ventureshrd.com/api/sitemap.xml' to 'https://ventureshrd.com/sitemap.xml' for consistency with the canonical proxied URL and cleaner GSC discovery.

For the original GSC 'Invalid sitemap address' issue on prod: since preview backend works fine and prod curl also returns valid XML per user context, the issue is likely a GSC-side caching/property-verification quirk. Recommend resubmitting in GSC after robots.txt fix, or waiting 24-48h for re-crawl.
critical_code_review_comments: robots.txt Sitemap directive uses /api/sitemap.xml instead of the canonical /sitemap.xml public URL — minor inconsistency worth aligning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sitemap and robots endpoints verified working on preview backend. Sitemap has 141 URLs, valid XML per sitemaps.org 0.9 schema. Only minor issue: robots.txt Sitemap directive uses /api/sitemap.xml rather than the canonical /sitemap.xml.
